item.title: Splat 1.0.17
item.description:
- **Links that lead nowhere.** In the preview, a link to a file that is not there, a wiki link to a note no folder holds, or a link to a heading the document lacks shows in red, and its tool tip says so. The mark goes once the file or heading is there. - **PlantUML 1.2026.10.** Chen diagrams render now.
Something wrong or missing? [Report it on GitHub](https://github.com/sventmueller/splat/issues/new/choose).
